sections.text:
Ability Power 100. Damages all enemies 3 - 6 times with dark magic damage. Chance to miss. 
Added effect: Activates Karma on all enemies and increases the magic Ability Power of all Mage-Class allies by 30 for 60 seconds.
Level bonus: Ability Power of this Ability's damage boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
